Axiom:
Touching a V2 file preserves its semantic-owner header; task history stays in tickets and Git.
- Required V2 fields, in order: `@file:`, one canonical `@spec:` ID, `@consumers:`. - New V2 file: create all three from the resolved owner spec and its named consumers. - Existing V2 file: preserve `@file:` and `@consumers:`; keep `@spec:` on the resolved semantic owner. A real ownership transfer is a semantic spec change and routes through authoring. - Existing V1 file remains byte-preserved until its migration owns the header rewrite. - Never add a Task-ID to a V2 source header; re-dispatch and later rounds change resolver state, not header history.
